neet_che_u03_t10_1.working: There are 3 equivalent resonance forms. In each form, one of the 3 C–O bonds is a double bond. Total bond order 4 divided over 3 bonds gives 4/3.

neet_che_u03_t10_2.working: Ozone is a resonance hybrid, so both O–O bonds are equivalent. Their length is intermediate between 148 and 121 pm; the experimental value is 128 pm.

neet_che_u03_t10_4.working: Benzene resonates between two Kekulé structures. This makes all C–C bonds equivalent with bond order 1.5, giving the same length of 139 pm. R correctly explains A.
